solve_orthogonal_matching_pursuit: solve Orthogonal Matching Pursuit problems using design matrix X and target vector y
solve_omp_with_gram_matrix: solve Orthogonal Matching Pursuit using precomputed Gram matrix and X-transpose-y vector
fit_omp_model: fit an Orthogonal Matching Pursuit regression model with configurable non-zero coefficients and tolerance
cross_validate_omp_model: cross-validate Orthogonal Matching Pursuit to find optimal number of non-zero coefficients
compute_omp_residuals: compute prediction residuals on test data for a full OMP coefficient path
